# Android NDK build for the ChessEngine Nitro module.
#
# TEMPLATE — the nitrogen autolinking .cmake (generated by `npm run codegen`)
# defines the generated sources and links React/Nitro. The project-specific bit
# is adding the repo's header-only engine (../../../core) to the include path.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.9.0)
project(ChessEngine)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

add_library(ChessEngine SHARED
  ../cpp/HybridChessEngine.hpp
)

# Pull in nitrogen-generated sources + React/Nitro linkage (HybridChessEngineSpec,
# the MoveResult struct, autolinking registration).
include(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../nitrogen/generated/android/ChessEngine+autolinking.cmake)

target_include_directories(ChessEngine PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../cpp
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../core   # repo/core — chess.hpp + game.hpp (header-only)
)
